/bin/bash -lc 'set -u
research_tmp=$(mktemp -d "$TMPDIR/career-college.XXXXXX")
printf '"'tmp=%s\\n' \""'$research_tmp"
for url in '"\\
  'https://www.nirfindia.org/Rankings/2025/CollegeRankingALL.html' \\
  'https://www.nirfindia.org/Rankings/2025/OverallRankingALL.html'; do
  name="'$(printf '"'%s' \""'$url" | sed '"'s#["'^A-Za-z0-9]#_#g'"')
  echo \"--- "'$url ---"
  if curl -L --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 30 "$url" -o "$research_tmp/$name.html"; then
    wc -c "$research_tmp/$name.html"
    rg -n -i -C 3 '"'Career College|Bhopal' \""'$research_tmp/$name.html" | head -80 || true
  else
    echo '"'curl_failed'
  fi
done
printf '\\n--- sqlite schema/nodes ---\\n'
sqlite3 -readonly assets/data/career_path.db \".tables\" 
sqlite3 -readonly assets/data/career_path.db \"PRAGMA table_info(career_nodes);\" 
"

H2 ABOUT COLLEGE
P True to its name, Career College, Bhopal, stands as a pioneer in the realm of education, devoted to equipping students with the knowledge and skills vital for prosperous career journeys.
P Affiliated with Barkatullah University, Bhopal, and eminent as NAAC's prestigious A+ accreditation (3.28 CGPA), our institution delivers a wide-ranging array of undergraduate and postgraduate programs spanning various disciplines such as Biotechnology, Microbiology, Chemistry, Zoology, Botany, Physics, Mathematics, Commerce and Management, Computer Science, Physiotherapy, Paramedical, and Library Science. Complementing our academic offerings are three esteemed Research Centers—CRICS (Centre for Research in Chemical Sciences), CRC (Computer Research Centre), and RCC (Research Centre for Commerce)—devoted to ground-breaking research that exceeds conventional boundaries.
P In our commitment to student advancement, Career College provides a wealth of online certification programs, including offerings from reputed institutions like Deakin University, Australia, Harvard Business School, IIT Bombay' s Spoken Tutorial Certification Program, NPTEL Certification Courses, Coursera, and IGNOU, alongside a plethora of UGC-NSQF accredited value-added courses. As an official partner institute of 'Study in India,' under the Ministry of Education, Government of India, we extend prospects for global learning experiences.

H2 About Career College
P Career College is an AICTE-approved autonomous institution under the UGC Scheme (Affiliated to Barkatullah University, Bhopal) and is accredited by NAAC as an A+ (3.28 CGPA). Our institution offers a diverse range of programs covering various disciplines, including undergraduate and postgraduate studies in Biotechnology, Microbiology, Chemistry, Zoology, Botany, Physics, Mathematics, Commerce and Management, Computer Science, Physiotherapy, Paramedical, and Library Science. Moreover, we take pride in our four esteemed Research Centers : CRICS (Centre for Research in Chemical Sciences), CRC (Computer Research Centre), RCC (Research Centre for Commerce), and CBRC (Career Botany Research Center) devoted to fostering impactful research that extends beyond traditional academic boundaries. Career College Bhopal has 56 years of academic experience and ranks among the top colleges in central India.

/bin/bash -lc 'set -u
research_tmp=$(find "$TMPDIR" -maxdepth 1 -type d -name '"'career-college.*' | sort | tail -1)
base='https://www.careercollegeindia.com'
for path in 'certificate-courses' 'Programmes-Structure-NEP-Based' 'information-brochure' 'admission-process' 'salient-features' 'document-list' 'contact' 'about' 'ccb-at-a-glance'; do
 out=\""'$research_tmp/ex_$(printf '"'%s' \""'$path" | tr '"'/?&=' '____').html\"
 curl -k -L --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 45 \""'$base/$path" -o "$out" || continue
done
python3 - "$research_tmp" <<'"'PY'
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from pathlib import Path
import sys,re
root=Path(sys.argv[1])
for p in sorted(root.glob('ex_*.html')):
 s=BeautifulSoup(p.read_text(errors='ignore'),'html.parser')
 for x in s(['script','style','noscript','svg','header','footer','nav']): x.decompose()
 print(f'\\n### {p.name} ###')
 # only content words and links excluding menu/footer; print unique headings, paragraphs, anchors with non-trivial href
 seen=set()
 for tag in s.find_all(['h1','h2','h3','h4','p','li','a']):
  txt=' '.join(tag.get_text(' ',strip=True).split())
  if not txt or txt in seen: continue
  if 'Career College Bhopal is among' in txt: break
  if tag.name in ('h1','h2','h3','h4') or (tag.name=='p' and len(txt)>40) or (tag.name=='a' and tag.get('href') not in ('#','/')):
   # omit common repeated nav links, footer utilities
   low=txt.lower()
   if tag.name=='a' and low in {'hindi','english','student login','admission 2026-27','admission 2025-26','naac','nirf','nsdc','sii','birac','career flare'}: continue
   print((tag.name.upper()+': ')+ (f'[{tag.get(\"href\")}] ' if tag.name=='a' else '') +txt)
  seen.add(txt)
PY
"

WITH RECURSIVE tree(id, slug, name, parent_id, breadcrumb) AS (
 SELECT id, slug, name, parent_id, name FROM career_nodes WHERE parent_id IS NULL

/bin/bash -lc 'set -u
research_tmp=$(find "$TMPDIR" -maxdepth 1 -type d -name '"'career-college.*' | sort | tail -1)
python3 - \""'$research_tmp" <<'"'PY'
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from pathlib import Path
import sys
root=Path(sys.argv[1])
for name in ['under-graduate-programmes.html','post-graduate-programmes.html','honours-programmes.html','apprenticeship-embedded-degree-program.html']:
 s=BeautifulSoup((root/name).read_text(errors='ignore'),'html.parser')
 print('\\n###',name)
 for h in s.find_all('h2'):
  title=' '.join(h.get_text(' ',strip=True).split())
  if title.lower() in {'under graduate programmes','post graduate programmes','honours with research programmes','why choose honors with research programs?','apprenticeship embedded degree program (aedp)'}: continue
  print('COURSE:',title)
  el=h.find_next_sibling()
  while el and el.name"'!='"'h2':
   txt=' '.join(el.get_text(' ',strip=True).split())
   if txt and txt.lower() not in {'more details'}: print(' ',el.name.upper()+':',txt)
   el=el.find_next_sibling()
PY
"

python3 - "$research_tmp" <<'"'PY'
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from pathlib import Path
import sys
root=Path(sys.argv[1])
for p in sorted(root.glob('cat_*.html')):
 s=BeautifulSoup(p.read_text(errors='ignore'),'html.parser')
 for x in s(['script','style','noscript','svg','header','footer','nav']): x.decompose()
 print('\\n###',p.name)
 # h and content paragraphs/list, dedupe only exact per page
 seen=set(); started=False
 for tag in s.find_all(['h1','h2','h3','h4','p','li','a']):
  txt=' '.join(tag.get_text(' ',strip=True).split())
  if not txt or txt in seen: continue
  if tag.name in ('h1','h2') and not started: started=True
  if not started: continue
  if 'Career College Bhopal is among' in txt: break
  low=txt.lower()
  if tag.name in ('h1','h2','h3','h4') or (tag.name=='p' and len(txt)>35) or (tag.name=='li' and len(txt)<180 and any(k in low for k in ['b.sc','b.com','bca','bba','m.sc','m.com','mpt','m.lib','ph.d','certificate','diploma','program','course','bpt','bmlt','bxrt','physiotherapy','botany','zoology','microbiology','chemistry','computer'])) or (tag.name=='a' and tag.get('href') and tag.get('href') not in ['#','/'] and len(txt)<120):
    if tag.name=='a': print('A',tag.get('href'),txt)
    else: print(tag.name.upper(),txt)
  seen.add(txt)
PY
"
